shloka_text: अथ पुत्रः पुलस्त्यस्य विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः । अचिरेणैव कालेन पितेव तपसि स्थितः ।। 7.3.1 ।।
transliteration: atha putraḥ pulastyasya viśravā munipuṅgavaḥ | acireṇaiva kālena piteva tapasi sthitaḥ || 7.3.1 ||
translation: अथ then, पुत्रः the son, पुलस्त्यस्य of Pulastya, विश्रवाः Vishrava, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages, अचिरेण एव in a short time, कालेन by time, पिता इव like his father, तपसि in penance, स्थितः engaged.
explanation: Then, Vishrava, the son of Pulastya and foremost among sages, soon became engaged in penance just like his father.
comments: Vishravas weds Bharadvaja's daughter and begets Vaishravana (Kubera) -- by severe penance Kubera wins from Brahma the lordship of wealth, the rank of world-guardian, and the Pushpaka chariot -- at his father's counsel he settles in Lanka on Mount Trikuta, built by Vishvakarma and once abandoned by the rakshasas who fled to Patala in fear of Vishnu -- Kubera dwells there in prosperity.

shloka_text: सत्यवाञ्छीलवाञ्छान्तः स्वाध्यायनिरतः शुचिः । सर्वभोगेष्वसंसक्तो नित्यं धर्मपरायणः ।। 7.3.2 ।।
transliteration: satyavāñchīlavāñchāntaḥ svādhyāyanirataḥ śuciḥ | sarvabhogeṣvasaṃsakto nityaṃ dharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 7.3.2 ||
translation: सत्यवान् truthful, शीलवान् virtuous, शान्तः peaceful, स्वाध्यायनिरतः devoted to self-study, शुचिः pure, सर्वभोगेषु in all enjoyments, असंसक्तः unattached, नित्यम् always, धर्मपरायणः devoted to righteousness.
explanation: He was truthful, virtuous, peaceful, devoted to Vedic study, pure, unattached to all worldly enjoyments, and constantly dedicated to righteousness.

shloka_text: ज्ञात्वा तस्य तु तद्वृत्तं भरद्वाजो महामुनिः । ददौ विश्रवसे भार्यां स्वसुतां देववर्णिनीम् ।। 7.3.3 ।।
transliteration: jñātvā tasya tu tadvṛttaṃ bharadvājo mahāmuniḥ | dadau viśravase bhāryāṃ svasutāṃ devavarṇinīm || 7.3.3 ||
translation: ज्ञात्वा having known, तस्य his, तु indeed, तत् वृत्तम् that conduct, भरद्वाजः Bharadvaja, महामुनिः the great sage, ददौ gave, विश्रवसे to Vishrava, भार्याम् a wife, स्वसुताम् his own daughter, देववर्णिनीम् Devavarnini.
explanation: Understanding Vishrava's excellent character, the great sage Bharadvaja gave his own daughter, Devavarnini, as a wife to Vishrava.

shloka_text: प्रतिगृह्य तु धर्मेण भरद्वाजसुतां तदा । प्रजान्वेक्षिकया बुद्ध्या श्रेयो ह्यस्य विचिन्तयन् ।। 7.3.4 ।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya tu dharmeṇa bharadvājasutāṃ tadā | prajānvekṣikayā buddhyā śreyo hyasya vicintayan || 7.3.4 ||
translation: प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, तु indeed, धर्मेण righteously, भरद्वाजसुताम् Bharadvaja's daughter, तदा then, प्रजान्वेक्षिकया with a mind intent on progeny, बुद्ध्या with understanding, श्रेयः the welfare, हि indeed, अस्य his, विचिन्तयन् contemplating.
explanation: Then, Vishrava, having righteously accepted Bharadvaja's daughter, contemplated his welfare with an intellect focused on the desire for progeny.

shloka_text: मुदा परमया युक्तो विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः । स तस्यां वीर्यसम्पन्नमपत्यं परमाद्भुतम् ।। 7.3.5 ।।
transliteration: mudā paramayā yukto viśravā munipuṅgavaḥ | sa tasyāṃ vīryasampannamapatyaṃ paramādbhutam || 7.3.5 ||
translation: मुदा with joy, परमया supreme, युक्तो endowed, विश्रवा Vishrava, मुनिपुङ्गवः foremost among sages, स he, तस्यां in her, वीर्यसम्पन्नम् endowed with valor, अपत्यं an offspring, परमाद्भुतम् exceedingly wonderful
explanation: The foremost sage Vishrava, filled with supreme joy, begot in her an exceedingly wonderful offspring endowed with great valor.

shloka_text: जनयामास धर्मज्ञः सर्वैर्ब्रह्मगुणैर्युतम् । तस्मिञ्जाते तु संहृष्टः सम्बभूव पितामहः ।। 7.3.6 ।।
transliteration: janayāmāsa dharmajñaḥ sarvairbrahmaguṇairyutam | tasmiñjāte tu saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sambabhūva pitāmahaḥ || 7.3.6 ||
translation: जनयामास begot, धर्मज्ञः the knower of Dharma, सर्वैर्ब्रह्मगुणैर्युतम् endowed with all divine qualities, तस्मिञ्जाते when he was born, तु indeed, संहृष्टः greatly delighted, सम्बभूव became, पितामहः the grandfather (Brahma)
explanation: This knower of Dharma begot a child endowed with all divine qualities, and when he was born, the grandfather (Brahma) became greatly delighted.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा श्रेयस्करीं बुद्धिं धनाध्यक्षो भविष्यति । नाम तस्याकरोत्प्रीतः सार्धं देवर्षिभिस्तदा ।। 7.3.7 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā śreyaskarīṃ buddhiṃ dhanādhyakṣo bhaviṣyati | nāma tasyākarotprītaḥ sārdhaṃ devarṣibhistadā || 7.3.7 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, श्रेयस्करीं auspicious, बुद्धिं intention, धनाध्यक्षो lord of wealth, भविष्यति will be, नाम a name, तस्याकरोत् he made for him, प्रीतः pleased, सार्धं together with, देवर्षिभिस्तदा the divine sages then
explanation: Having perceived his auspicious intention to become the lord of wealth, the pleased grandfather (Brahma), together with the divine sages, then gave him a name.

shloka_text: यस्माद्विश्रवसो ऽपत्यं सादृश्याद्विश्रवा इव । तस्माद्वैश्रवणो नाम भविष्यत्वेष विश्रुतः ।। 7.3.8 ।।
transliteration: yasmādviśravaso 'patyaṃ sādṛśyādviśravā iva | tasmādvaiśravaṇo nāma bhaviṣyatveṣa viśrutaḥ || 7.3.8 ||
translation: यस्मात् because, विश्रवसो of Vishrava, अपत्यं the offspring, सादृश्यात् due to resemblance, विश्रवा Vishrava, इव like, तस्मात् therefore, वैश्रवणो Vaishravana, नाम by name, भविष्यत्वेष this one will be, विश्रुतः renowned
explanation: Because this offspring of Vishrava resembles Vishrava himself, he will therefore be renowned by the name Vaishravana.

shloka_text: स तु वैश्रवणस्तत्र तपोवनगतस्तदा । अवर्धताहुतिहुतो महातेजा यथानलः ।। 7.3.9 ।।
transliteration: sa tu vaiśravaṇastatra tapovanagatastadā | avardhatāhutihuto mahātejā yathānalaḥ || 7.3.9 ||
translation: स he, तु indeed, वैश्रवणः Vaishravana, तत्र there, तपोवनगतः having gone to the hermitage, तदा then, अवर्धत grew, आहुतिहुतो nourished by oblations, महातेजा greatly effulgent, यथा like, अनलः fire
explanation: Then, Vaishravana, having gone to the hermitage, grew there, greatly effulgent, like a fire nourished by oblations.

shloka_text: तस्याश्रमपदस्थस्य बुद्धिर्जज्ञे महात्मनः । चरिष्ये परमं धर्मं धर्मो हि परमा गतिः ।। 7.3.10 ।।
transliteration: tasyāśramapadasthasya buddhirjajñe mahātmanaḥ | cariṣye paramaṃ dharmaṃ dharmo hi paramā gatiḥ || 7.3.10 ||
translation: तस्याश्रमपदस्थस्य residing in his hermitage, बुद्धिः thought, जज्ञे arose, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, चरिष्ये I shall practice, परमम् supreme, धर्मम् righteousness, धर्मः righteousness, हि indeed, परमा supreme, गतिः goal.
explanation: A thought arose in the mind of the great sage residing in his hermitage that he would practice supreme righteousness, for righteousness is indeed the ultimate goal.

shloka_text: स तु वर्षसहस्राणि तपस्तप्त्वा महावने । यन्त्रितो नियमैरुग्रैश्चकार सुमहत्तपः ।। 7.3.11 ।।
transliteration: sa tu varṣasahasrāṇi tapastaptvā mahāvane | yantrito niyamairugraiścakāra sumahattapaḥ || 7.3.11 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, वर्षसहस्राणि for thousands of years, तपः penance, तप्त्वा having performed, महावने in the great forest, यन्त्रितः restrained, नियमैः by vows, उग्रैः severe, चकार performed, सुमहत्तपः very great penance.
explanation: Indeed, he performed very great penance for thousands of years in the great forest, having restrained himself with severe vows.

shloka_text: पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रान्ते तं तं विधिमकल्पयत् । जलाशी मारुताहारो निराहारस्तथैव च ।। 7.3.12 ।।
transliteration: pūrṇe varṣasahasrānte taṃ taṃ vidhimakalpayat | jalāśī mārutāhāro nirāhārastathaiva ca || 7.3.12 ||
translation: पूर्णे at the completion, वर्षसहस्रान्ते of a thousand years, तम् तम् various, विधिम् methods, अकल्पयत् he adopted, जलाशी subsisting on water, मारुताहारः subsisting on air, निराहारः without food, तथैव च and similarly.
explanation: At the completion of each thousand years, he adopted various methods of austerity, such as subsisting only on water, then only on air, and then completely without food.

shloka_text: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि जग्मुस्तान्येकवर्षवत् । अथ प्रीतो महातेजाः सेन्द्रैः सुरगणैः सह ।। 7.3.13 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi jagmustānyekavarṣavat | atha prīto mahātejāḥ sendraiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha || 7.3.13 ||
translation: एवम् thus, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, जग्मुः passed, तानि those, एकवर्षवत् like a single year, अथ then, प्रीतः pleased, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, सेन्द्रैः with Indra, सुरगणैः with the hosts of gods, सह together.
explanation: Thus, those thousands of years passed as if they were a single year, and then the greatly effulgent Brahma, pleased, came with Indra and the hosts of gods.

shloka_text: गत्वा तस्याश्रमपदं ब्रह्मेदं वाक्यमब्रवीत् । परितुष्टो ऽस्मि ते वत्स कर्मणानेन सुव्रत । वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते वरार्हस्त्वं महामते ।। 7.3.14 ।।
transliteration: gatvā tasyāśramapadaṃ brahmedaṃ vākyamabravīt | parituṣṭo 'smi te vatsa karmaṇānena suvrata | varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te varārhastvaṃ mahāmate || 7.3.14 ||
translation: गत्वा having gone, तस्य his, आश्रमपदम् hermitage, ब्रह्मा Brahma, इदम् this, वाक्यम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke, परितुष्टः greatly pleased, अस्मि I am, ते with you, वत्स O child, कर्मणा by deed, अनेन this, सुव्रत O one of good vows, वरम् boon, वृणीष्व choose, भद्रम् welfare, ते to you, वरार्हः deserving of a boon, त्वम् you, महामते O great-minded one.
explanation: Having gone to his hermitage, Brahma spoke these words: "O child of good vows, I am greatly pleased with this deed of yours; choose a boon, may there be welfare for you, O great-minded one, for you are deserving of a boon."

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीद्वैश्रवणः पितामहमुपस्थितम् । भगवँल्लोकपालत्वमिच्छेयं वित्तरक्षणम् ।। 7.3.15 ।।
transliteration: athābravīdvaiśravaṇaḥ pitāmahamupasthitam | bhagavaँllokapālatvamiccheyaṃ vittarakṣaṇam || 7.3.15 ||
translation: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, वैश्रवणः Vaishravana, पितामहम् to the grandfather (Brahma), उपस्थितम् who was present, भगवन् O Lord, लोकपालत्वम् the state of being a world-protector, इच्छेयम् I desire, वित्तरक्षणम् the protection of wealth,
explanation: Then Vaishravana, standing before his grandfather Brahma, said, "O Lord, I desire to be a guardian of the world and a protector of wealth."

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीद्वैश्रवणं परितुष्टेन चेतसा । ब्रह्मा सुरगणैः सार्धं बाढमित्येव हृष्टवत् ।। 7.3.16 ।।
transliteration: athābravīdvaiśravaṇaṃ parituṣṭena cetasā | brahmā suragaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ bāḍhamityeva hṛṣṭavat || 7.3.16 ||
translation: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, वैश्रवणम् to Vaishravana, परितुष्टेन with a very pleased, चेतसा mind, ब्रह्मा Brahma, सुरगणैः with the hosts of gods, सार्धम् together with, बाढम् "So be it", इति thus, एव indeed, हृष्टवत् joyfully,
explanation: Then Brahma, with a very pleased mind, joyfully spoke to Vaishravana in the presence of the hosts of gods, saying, "So be it."

shloka_text: अहं वै लोकपालानां चतुर्थं स्रष्टुमुद्यतः ।। 7.3.17 ।।
transliteration: ahaṃ vai lokapālānāṃ caturthaṃ sraṣṭumudyataḥ || 7.3.17 ||
translation: अहम् I, वै indeed, लोकपालानाम् among the world-protectors, चतुर्थम् the fourth, स्रष्टुम् to create, उद्यतः was ready,
explanation: Brahma declared, "Indeed, I was about to create the fourth among the world-protectors."

shloka_text: यमेन्द्रवरुणानां च पदं यत्तव चेप्सितम् । तद्गच्छ त्वं हि धर्मज्ञ निधीशत्वमवाप्नुहि । शक्राम्बुपयमानां च चतुर्थस्त्वं भविष्यसि ।। 7.3.18 ।।
transliteration: yamendravaruṇānāṃ ca padaṃ yattava cepsitam | tadgaccha tvaṃ hi dharmajña nidhīśatvamavāpnuhi | śakrāmbupayamānāṃ ca caturthastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 7.3.18 ||
translation: यम Yama, इन्द्र Indra, वरुणानाम् and Varuna, च and, पदम् the position, यत् which, तव by you, च and, ईप्सितम् desired, तत् that, गच्छ attain, त्वम् you, हि indeed, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, निधीशत्वम् the state of being the lord of treasures, अवाप्नुहि obtain, शक्र Indra, अम्बुप Varuna, यमानाम् and Yama, च and, चतुर्थः the fourth, त्वम् you, भविष्यसि will be,
explanation: Brahma continued, "O righteous one, attain that desired position alongside Yama, Indra, and Varuna; indeed, obtain the lordship of treasures, and you shall be the fourth among Indra, Varuna, and Yama."

shloka_text: एतच्च पुष्पकं नाम विमानं सूर्यसन्निभम् । प्रतिगृह्णीष्व यानार्थं त्रिदशैः समतां व्रज ।। 7.3.19 ।।
transliteration: etacca puṣpakaṃ nāma vimānaṃ sūryasannibham | pratigṛhṇīṣva yānārthaṃ tridaśaiḥ samatāṃ vraja || 7.3.19 ||
translation: एतत् this, च and, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, नाम named, विमानम् aerial chariot, सूर्यसन्निभम् resembling the sun, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व accept, यानार्थम् for the purpose of travel, त्रिदशैः with the gods, समताम् equality, व्रज attain,
explanation: "And accept this aerial chariot named Pushpaka, which resembles the sun, for your travels, and thereby attain equality with the gods."

shloka_text: स्वस्ति ते ऽस्तु गमिष्यामः सर्व एव यथागतम् । कृतकृत्या वयं तात दत्त्वा तव वरद्वयम् ।। 7.3.20 ।।
transliteration: svasti te 'stu gamiṣyāmaḥ sarva eva yathāgatam | kṛtakṛtyā vayaṃ tāta dattvā tava varadvayam || 7.3.20 ||
translation: स्वस्ति well-being, ते to you, अस्तु let there be, गमिष्यामः we shall go, सर्व all, एव indeed, यथागतम् as we came, कृतकृत्याः having accomplished our purpose, वयम् we, तात dear son, दत्त्वा having given, तव your, वरद्वयम् two boons.
explanation: Brahma declared that they had accomplished their purpose by granting two boons and would now depart as they had arrived, wishing well-being upon the recipient.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा स गतो ब्रह्मा स्वस्थानं त्रिदशैः सह ।। 7.3.21 ।।
transliteration: ityuktvā sa gato brahmā svasthānaṃ tridaśaiḥ saha || 7.3.21 ||
translation: इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, सः he, गतः went, ब्रह्मा Brahma, स्वस्थानम् to his own abode, त्रिदशैः with the gods, सह together with.
explanation: Having spoken thus, Brahma returned to his own abode accompanied by the gods.

shloka_text: गतेषु ब्रह्मपूर्वेषु देवेष्वथ नभस्थलम् । वने स पितरं प्राह प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतात्मवान् । निवासनं न मे देवो विदधे स प्रजापतिः ।। 7.3.22 ।।
transliteration: gateṣu brahmapūrveṣu deveṣvatha nabhasthalam | vane sa pitaraṃ prāha prāñjaliḥ prayatātmavān | nivāsanaṃ na me devo vidadhe sa prajāpatiḥ || 7.3.22 ||
translation: गतेषु when they had gone, ब्रह्मपूर्वेषु led by Brahma, देवेषु the gods, अथ then, नभस्थलम् to the sky, वने in the forest, सः he, पितरम् to his father, प्राह said, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रयतात्मवान् with a controlled mind, निवासनम् a dwelling place, न not, मे for me, देवः the god, विदधे provided, सः that, प्रजापतिः lord of creatures.
explanation: After Brahma and the other gods departed to the heavens, Ravana, with folded hands and a controlled mind, addressed his father in the forest, stating that Brahma had not provided him with a dwelling place.

shloka_text: भगवँल्लब्धवानस्मि वरमिष्टं पितामहात् । तं पश्य भगवन्कञ्चिन्निवासं साधु मे प्रभो ।। 7.3.23 ।।
transliteration: bhagavaँllabdhavānasmi varamiṣṭaṃ pitāmahāt | taṃ paśya bhagavankañcinnivāsaṃ sādhu me prabho || 7.3.23 ||
translation: भगवन् O revered one, लब्धवान् I have obtained, अस्मि I am, वरम् a boon, इष्टम् desired, पितामहात् from the grandfather, तम् that, पश्य find, भगवन् O revered one, कञ्चित् some, निवासम् dwelling place, साधु suitable, मे for me, प्रभो O lord.
explanation: Ravana informed his father that he had received his desired boon from Brahma and requested his father to find a suitable dwelling place for him.

shloka_text: न च पीडा भवेद्यत्र प्राणिनो यस्य कस्यचित् । एवमुक्तस्तु पुत्रेण विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। 7.3.24 ।।
transliteration: na ca pīḍā bhavedyatra prāṇino yasya kasyacit | evamuktastu putreṇa viśravā munipuṅgavaḥ || 7.3.24 ||
translation: न not, च and, पीडा harm, भवेत् should be, यत्र where, प्राणिनः of a living being, यस्य कस्यचित् of any whatsoever, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, पुत्रेण by his son, विश्रवाः Vishrava, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages.
explanation: Ravana further specified that the dwelling place should be one where no living being would suffer any harm, and upon hearing this request from his son, Vishrava, the foremost among sages, considered it.

shloka_text: वचनं प्राह धर्मज्ञः श्रूयतामिति सत्तमः । दक्षिणस्योदधेस्तीरे त्रिकूटो नाम पर्वतः ।। 7.3.25 ।।
transliteration: vacanaṃ prāha dharmajñaḥ śrūyatāmiti sattamaḥ | dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre trikūṭo nāma parvataḥ || 7.3.25 ||
translation: वचनं word, प्राह said, धर्मज्ञः the knower of dharma, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, इति thus, सत्तमः the excellent one. दक्षिणस्य of the southern, उदधेः of the ocean, तीरे on the shore, त्रिकूटो Trikuta, नाम named, पर्वतः mountain.
explanation: The righteous and excellent one spoke, saying, "Listen! On the shore of the southern ocean, there is a mountain named Trikuta."

shloka_text: तस्याग्रे तु विशाला सा महेन्द्रस्य पुरी यथा । लङ्का नाम पुरी रम्या निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा ।। 7.3.26 ।।
transliteration: tasyāgre tu viśālā sā mahendrasya purī yathā | laṅkā nāma purī ramyā nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā || 7.3.26 ||
translation: तस्य of that (mountain), अग्रे on the top, तु indeed, विशाला vast, सा that, महेन्द्रस्य of Mahendra, पुरी city, यथा like. लङ्का Lanka, नाम named, पुरी city, रम्या beautiful, निर्मिता built, विश्वकर्मणा by Vishwakarma.
explanation: On the top of that mountain, there is a vast and beautiful city named Lanka, constructed by Vishwakarma, resembling the city of Mahendra (Indra).

shloka_text: राक्षसानां निवासार्थं यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती । तत्र त्वं वस भद्रं ते लङ्कायां नात्र संशयः ।। 7.3.27 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasānāṃ nivāsārthaṃ yathendrasyāmarāvatī | tatra tvaṃ vasa bhadraṃ te laṅkāyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 7.3.27 ||
translation: राक्षसानां of the Rakshasas, निवासार्थं for residence, यथा just as, इन्द्रस्य of Indra, अमरावती Amaravati. तत्र there, त्वं you, वस dwell, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, लङ्कायां in Lanka, न not, अत्र here, संशयः doubt.
explanation: That city is meant for the residence of Rakshasas, just as Amaravati is for Indra; you should dwell there in Lanka, and there is no doubt that it will bring you good fortune.

shloka_text: हेमप्राकारपरिघा यन्त्रशस्त्रसमावृता । रमणीया पुरी सा हि रुक्मवैडूर्यतोरणा ।। 7.3.28 ।।
transliteration: hemaprākāraparighā yantraśastrasamāvṛtā | ramaṇīyā purī sā hi rukmavaiḍūryatoraṇā || 7.3.28 ||
translation: हेमप्राकारपरिघा having golden ramparts and moats, यन्त्रशस्त्रसमावृता equipped with machines and weapons. रमणीया charming, पुरी city, सा that, हि indeed, रुक्म gold, वैडूर्य lapis lazuli, तोरणा having archways.
explanation: That delightful city is indeed equipped with golden ramparts and moats, fortified with machines and weapons, and adorned with archways made of gold and lapis lazuli.

shloka_text: राक्षसैः सा परित्यक्ता पुरा विष्णुभयार्दितैः । शून्या रक्षोगणैः सर्वै रसातलतलं गतैः ।। 7.3.29 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasaiḥ sā parityaktā purā viṣṇubhayārditaiḥ | śūnyā rakṣogaṇaiḥ sarvai rasātalatalaṃ gataiḥ || 7.3.29 ||
translation: राक्षसैः by the Rakshasas, सा that (city), परित्यक्ता abandoned, पुरा formerly, विष्णुभयार्दितैः afflicted by fear of Vishnu. शून्या empty, रक्षोगणैः by the hordes of Rakshasas, सर्वैः all, रसातलतलं to the nethermost region, गतैः having gone.
explanation: That city was formerly abandoned by all the hordes of Rakshasas, who, afflicted by fear of Vishnu, had gone to the nethermost regions, leaving it deserted.

shloka_text: शून्या सम्प्रति लङ्का सा प्रभुस्तस्या न विद्यते । स त्वं तत्र निवासाय गच्छ पुत्र यथासुखम् ।। 7.3.30 ।।
transliteration: śūnyā samprati laṅkā sā prabhustasyā na vidyate | sa tvaṃ tatra nivāsāya gaccha putra yathāsukham || 7.3.30 ||
translation: शून्या empty, सम्प्रति now, लङ्का Lanka, सा that, प्रभुः lord, तस्याः of it, न not, विद्यते exists, सः therefore, त्वम् you, तत्र there, निवासाय for dwelling, गच्छ go, पुत्र son, यथासुखम् comfortably.
explanation: That Lanka is now empty and without a master, so you, my son, should go and reside there comfortably.

shloka_text: निर्दोषस्तत्र ते वासो न बाधास्तत्र कस्यचित् । एतच्छुत्वा स धर्मात्मा धर्मिष्ठं वचनं पितुः ।। 7.3.31 ।।
transliteration: nirdoṣastatra te vāso na bādhāstatra kasyacit | etacchutvā sa dharmātmā dharmiṣṭhaṃ vacanaṃ pituḥ || 7.3.31 ||
translation: निर्दोषः faultless, तत्र there, ते your, वासः dwelling, न not, बाधाः obstacles, तत्र there, कस्यचित् of anyone, एतत् this, श्रुत्वा having heard, सः he, धर्मात्मा righteous soul, धर्मिष्ठम् most righteous, वचनम् word, पितुः of the father.
explanation: Your dwelling there will be without hindrance, and there will be no obstacles from anyone; having heard this most righteous command from his father, that righteous soul (Kubera)...

shloka_text: निवासयामास तदा लङ्कां पर्वतमूर्धनि । नैर्ऋतानां सहस्रैस्तु हृष्टैः प्रमुदुतैः सह ।। 7.3.32 ।।
transliteration: nivāsayāmāsa tadā laṅkāṃ parvatamūrdhani | nairṛtānāṃ sahasraistu hṛṣṭaiḥ pramudutaiḥ saha || 7.3.32 ||
translation: निवासयामास caused to dwell, तदा then, लङ्काम् Lanka, पर्वतमूर्धनि on the mountain top, नैर्ऋतानाम् of the Rakshasas, सहस्रैः with thousands, तु indeed, हृष्टैः delighted, प्रमुदुतैः greatly joyful, सह with.
explanation: ...then settled Lanka, situated on the mountain top, with thousands of delighted and greatly joyful Rakshasas.

shloka_text: अचिरेणैव कालेन सम्पूर्णा तस्य शासनात् ।। 7.3.33 ।।
transliteration: acireṇaiva kālena sampūrṇā tasya śāsanāt || 7.3.33 ||
translation: अचिरेण in a short, एव indeed, कालेन time, सम्पूर्णा filled, तस्य his, शासनात् by command.
explanation: In a very short time, Lanka was completely filled by his command.

shloka_text: स तु तत्रावसत्प्रीतो धर्मात्मा नैर्ऋतर्षभः । समुद्रपरिघायां तु लङ्कायां विश्रवात्मजः ।। 7.3.34 ।।
transliteration: sa tu tatrāvasatprīto dharmātmā nairṛtarṣabhaḥ | samudraparighāyāṃ tu laṅkāyāṃ viśravātmajaḥ || 7.3.34 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, तत्र there, अवसत् dwelt, प्रीतः pleased, धर्मात्मा righteous soul, नैर्ऋतर्षभः chief of Rakshasas, समुद्रपरिघायाम् surrounded by the ocean, तु indeed, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, विश्रवात्मजः son of Vishrava.
explanation: That righteous soul, the chief of Rakshasas and son of Vishrava (Kubera), happily dwelt there in Lanka, which was surrounded by the ocean.

shloka_text: काले काले तु धर्मात्मा पुष्पकेण धनेश्वरः । अभ्यागच्छद्विनीतात्मा पितरं मातरं च हि ।। 7.3.35 ।।
transliteration: kāle kāle tu dharmātmā puṣpakeṇa dhaneśvaraḥ | abhyāgacchadvinītātmā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca hi || 7.3.35 ||
translation: काले काले from time to time, तु indeed, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, पुष्पकेण by Pushpaka, धनेश्वरः lord of wealth, अभ्यागच्छत् used to come, विनीतात्मा humble-souled, पितरं father, मातरं mother, च and, हि indeed.
explanation: The righteous and humble Kubera, the lord of wealth, used to visit his father and mother from time to time in his Pushpaka chariot.

shloka_text: स देवगन्धर्वगणैरभिष्टुतस्तथाप्सरोनृत्यविभूषितालयः । गभस्तिभिः सूर्य इवावभासयन्पितुः समीपं प्रययौ स वित्तपः ।। 7.3.36 ।।
transliteration: sa devagandharvagaṇairabhiṣṭutastathāpsaronṛtyavibhūṣitālayaḥ | gabhastibhiḥ sūrya ivāvabhāsayanpituḥ samīpaṃ prayayau sa vittapaḥ || 7.3.36 ||
translation: सः he, देवगन्धर्वगणैः by hosts of gods and gandharvas, अभिष्टुतः praised, तथा and, अप्सरोनृत्यविभूषितालयः whose abode was adorned by the dances of Apsaras, गभस्तिभिः by rays, सूर्यः sun, इव like, अवभासयन् illuminating, पितुः father's, समीपं proximity, प्रययौ went, सः he, वित्तपः lord of wealth.
explanation: Praised by hosts of gods and Gandharvas, and with his abode adorned by the dances of Apsaras, that lord of wealth, Kubera, approached his father, shining like the sun with its rays. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे तृतीयः सर्गः ।। 3 ।। Thus ends the third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
